prior_work: No scala/bug ticket. Regression from 2.12.0 (SAM refactoring dropped the parent; 'Bring back AbstractFunction parent' rebuilt it from fun.body.tpe.deconst; 2.11 used abstractFunctionForFunctionType(fun.tpe)). No fork PR touches expandFunction (retronym/scala#395 and #542 touch nearby delambdafy code, no overlap). scala/bug#10564 is a different -Ydelambdafy:inline failure.
unsure: The fix changes the superclass of expanded lambdas with constant bodies (now specialized, as in 2.11) and the generic signature of expanded lambdas whose result type is packed (a local class becomes Object). Binary compatible (anonymous classes), but class files under -Ydelambdafy:inline change for those. The flag-wide partest coverage was the grep subsets, not all categories.
note: expandFunction now takes the AbstractFunctionN type arguments from fun.tpe (dealiased), which typer builds from the parameter symbols and the packed body type, and which the generated apply method already used for its result type. The constant-type leak into the parent came with literal types and is fixed by the same change.
